host-p1.mp3.speaker: host
host-p1.mp3.label: p1
host-p1.mp3.text: The clay under the back border stays wet all winter, so I forked in leaf mould and coarse grit last autumn.

host-p2.mp3.speaker: host
host-p2.mp3.label: p2
host-p2.mp3.text: Slugs shredded the young hostas again, but the copper ring around the raised bed seems to be holding them off.

host-p3.mp3.speaker: host
host-p3.mp3.label: p3
host-p3.mp3.text: I moved the compost heap nearer the shed and turned it twice, and the middle is already warm enough to steam.

host-p4.mp3.speaker: host
host-p4.mp3.label: p4
host-p4.mp3.text: Pruning the espaliered pear too late cost me most of the fruiting spurs, so this year I cut back in midsummer.

host-ov.mp3.speaker: host
host-ov.mp3.label: ov
host-ov.mp3.text: The greenhouse vents jam whenever the humidity climbs, so I prop them open with a length of bamboo cane.

alpha-p1.mp3.speaker: alpha
alpha-p1.mp3.label: p1
alpha-p1.mp3.text: We reefed early because the forecast promised gusts through the afternoon, and the swell was already stacking up outside the harbour.

alpha-p2.mp3.speaker: alpha
alpha-p2.mp3.label: p2
alpha-p2.mp3.text: The tide turned against us near the headland, so we ferry glided across and let the current do the work.

alpha-p3.mp3.speaker: alpha
alpha-p3.mp3.label: p3
alpha-p3.mp3.text: Halyards slap all night in the marina, which is why I lash them away from the mast before turning in.

alpha-p4.mp3.speaker: alpha
alpha-p4.mp3.label: p4
alpha-p4.mp3.text: Anchoring in that bay is fine on sand, but the weed patches nearer the shore refuse to hold a hook.

alpha-ov.mp3.speaker: alpha
alpha-ov.mp3.label: ov
alpha-ov.mp3.text: Our chartplotter lost its fix twice on the crossing, so we fell back on the compass and a paper chart.

bravo-p1.mp3.speaker: bravo
bravo-p1.mp3.label: p1
bravo-p1.mp3.text: My starter doubles overnight now, which means the kitchen has finally warmed up enough for a decent rise.

bravo-p2.mp3.speaker: bravo
bravo-p2.mp3.label: p2
bravo-p2.mp3.text: Scoring the loaf deeper gave a much better ear, though the crumb is still tighter than I would like.

bravo-p3.mp3.speaker: bravo
bravo-p3.mp3.label: p3
bravo-p3.mp3.text: I switched to a wetter dough and stretched it in the bowl instead of kneading it on the counter.

bravo-p4.mp3.speaker: bravo
bravo-p4.mp3.label: p4
bravo-p4.mp3.text: Steam matters more than heat at the start, so I throw a tray of boiling water onto the oven floor.

bravo-ov.mp3.speaker: bravo
bravo-ov.mp3.label: ov
bravo-ov.mp3.text: Rye behaves nothing like wheat, it goes sticky under the hands and needs a far shorter proof.

charlie-p1.mp3.speaker: charlie
charlie-p1.mp3.label: p1
charlie-p1.mp3.text: Collimation drifts every time I carry the scope down the stairs, so I check the secondary mirror before anything else.

charlie-p2.mp3.speaker: charlie
charlie-p2.mp3.label: p2
charlie-p2.mp3.text: Seeing was poor last night, the planet boiled at high magnification and only settled during a few brief gaps.

charlie-p3.mp3.speaker: charlie
charlie-p3.mp3.label: p3
charlie-p3.mp3.text: Light pollution washes out the fainter galaxies, but the narrowband filter still pulls the nebula out of the glow.

charlie-p4.mp3.speaker: charlie
charlie-p4.mp3.label: p4
charlie-p4.mp3.text: Tracking held well until the counterweight slipped, and after that every long exposure trailed right across the frame.

charlie-ov.mp3.speaker: charlie
charlie-ov.mp3.label: ov
charlie-ov.mp3.text: Dew on the corrector plate ends the session faster than cloud, so the heater strip goes on early.
